anyType.Code:
'Ermittelt den eingegebenen Problemtext und schreibt die ersten 100 'Zeichen in die Betreffzeile und des Vorgangs. 'Selects the first 100 characters from the problem description 'and enters them in the subject of the Case strProblem = hlObj.GetValue("CaseDescription.DescriptionText",0,0,0,0) ProblemString = Left(strProblem,100) varSubject = replace(ProblemString,Chr(13)&Chr(10)," ") CaseSubject = hlObj.GetValue("CaseGeneral.Subject",0,0,0,0) If CaseSubject = "" Then hlObj.SetValue "CaseGeneral.Subject",0,0,0,varSubject End If

If level = "EscalationLevelLevel2" Then hlObj.SetValue "IncidentAttribute.IncidentStatus",0,0,0,"IncidentStatusRouted" End If If level = "EscalationLevelLevel1" Then hlObj.SetValue "IncidentAttribute.IncidentStatus",0,0,0,"IncidentStatusRouted" End if

anyType.Name: OnCreate
anyType.Code:
'Ermitteln der Locale ID für die Sprachauswahl 'Selecting the Locale ID for the desired language lcid = hlSession.GetLocaleID LangID = hlSession.LangIDFromLCID(lcid)
'Dieser Scriptteil setzt abhängig von der Sprache die Vorschlagsliste 'für die Reaktionszeit und Lösungszeit und bestimmt die Default Reaktionszeit 'This script sets depending on the language the suggestion 'list for the reaction and solution time and determines the default reaction time DefReacTime = "" Select Case LangID Case "7" 'Setzen der deutschen Vorschlagsliste für Reaktionszeiten 'Setting the German suggestion list for reaction times Counter=EditReactionTime.GetItemsCount If Counter <= 0 Then EditReactionTime.AddItem "Sofort" EditReactionTime.AddItem "2 Stunden" EditReactionTime.AddItem "4 Stunden" EditReactionTime.AddItem "8 Stunden" EditReactionTime.AddItem "1 Tag" EditReactionTime.AddItem "2 Tage" EditReactionTime.AddItem "4 Tage" EditReactionTime.AddItem "5 Tage" EditReactionTime.AddItem "10 Tage" EditReactionTime.AddItem "20 Tage" End If DefReacTime = "2 Stunden"
'Setzen der deutschen Vorschlagsliste für Versprochene Lösungszeit 'Setting the German suggestion list for agreed solution time Counter=EditPromisedSolutionTime.GetItemsCount If Counter <= 0 Then EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "Sofort" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "2 Stunden" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "4 Stunden" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "8 Stunden" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "1 Tag" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "2 Tage" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "4 Tage" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "5 Tage" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "10 Tage" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "20 Tage" End If
Case "9" 'Setzen der englischen Vorschlagsliste für Reaktionszeiten 'Setting the English suggestion list for reaction time Counter=EditReactionTime.GetItemsCount If Counter <= 0 Then EditReactionTime.AddItem "Immediately" EditReactionTime.AddItem "2 hours" EditReactionTime.AddItem "4 hours" EditReactionTime.AddItem "8 hours" EditReactionTime.AddItem "1 day" EditReactionTime.AddItem "2 days" EditReactionTime.AddItem "4 days" EditReactionTime.AddItem "5 days" EditReactionTime.AddItem "10 days" EditReactionTime.AddItem "20 days" End If DefReacTime = "2 hours"
'Setzen der englischen Vorschlagsliste für Versprochene Lösungszeit 'Setting the English suggestion list for agreed solution time Counter=EditPromisedSolutionTime.GetItemsCount If Counter <= 0 Then EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "Immediately" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "2 hours" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "4 hours" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "8 hours" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "1 day" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "2 days" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "4 days" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "5 days" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "10 days" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "20 days" End If End Select 'Setzten der Standard Reaktionszeit auf den Wert aus der Variablen DefReacTime 'Setting the default reaction time for the value retrieved from the variable DefReacTime If ReadOnly=False Then If EditReactionTime.Text = "" Then hlObj.SetValue "CASEINFO.REACTIONTIME",0,0,0,DefReacTime End If

anyType.Name: OnEdit
anyType.Code:
Dim ReadOnly, NoPerson, NoAsset ReadOnly = True NoPerson = True NoAsset = True
'Zunächst überprüfen ob der Vorgang schreibgeschützt ist 'First of all check whether the Case is write protected If hlObj.IsReadOnly("CASEINFO.REACTIONTIME",0)=0 Then ReadOnly=False End If
'Prüft ob ein Anfrager Objekt vorhanden ist und ob dieses auch angezeigt wird 'Check wether the Caller object exist If IsObject(hlCaller) = True And EditSurname.Text <> "" Then NoPerson = False End If
'Prüft ob ein Produkt Objekt vorhanden ist und ob dieses auch angezeigt wird 'Check wether the Product object exist If IsObject(hlProduct) = True And EditAssetModel.Text <> "" Then NoAsset = False End If
'Ermitteln der Locale ID für die Sprachauswahl 'Selecting the Locale ID for the desired language lcid = hlSession.GetLocaleID LangID = hlSession.LangIDFromLCID(lcid)
If NoPerson = False Then 'Setzten des Anfrager Namen 'Setting requester name varString="" If EditGivenName.Text <> "" Then varString=EditGivenName.Text & " " If EditSurname.Text <> "" Then varString=varString & EditSurname.Text
'Ermitteln der Org Einheit 'Selecting the organizational unit Dim strOrgUnit strOrgUnit = hlCaller.GetValue("PersonInformation.PersonOrganisation",0,0,0,0) If strOrgUnit <> "" Then varString = varString & "; " & strOrgUnit End If
'Ermitteln der Telefonnummer 'Selecting the phone number Dim strPhone strPhone = hlCaller.GetValue("PersonInformation.PhoneNumber",0,0,0,0) If strPhone <> "" Then varString = varString & ", " & strPhone End If
'Ermittelt die Standard E-Mail Adresse 'Selecting the default e-mail address Dim strEmail strEmail = hlCaller.GetValue("PersonInformation.EmailAddress",0,0,0,0) If strEmail <> "" Then varString = varString & ", " & strEmail End If InfoCaller.Text=varString
'Ermitteln der Benachrichtigung 'Selecting the notification If ReadOnly = False Then DefNotif=hlObj.GetValue("CaseGeneral.DefaultNotification",0,0,0,0) If DefNotif = "" Then Valid=hlCaller.HasContent("PersonGeneral.DefaultNotification",0,0) If Valid = 1 Then Notify = hlCaller.GetValue("PersonGeneral.DefaultNotification",0,0,0,1) hlObj.SetValue "CaseGeneral.DefaultNotification",0,0,0,Notify End If End If End If
'Ermitteln der Kostenstellen des Anfragers und füllen der Auswahlliste 'Selecting the cost center assigned to the requester and filling the selection list If ReadOnly = False Then CounterC=EditCostCenter.GetItemsCount If CounterC <= 1 Then CCContID = hlCaller.GetContentIDs ("PersonBilling.CostCenter_CA",0) val=ubound(CCContID) If val >= 0 Then For j=0 To val CostC = hlCaller.GetValue ("PersonBilling.CostCenter_CA.CostCenter",0,CCContID(j),0,0) EditCostCenter.AddItem "" & CostC & "" Next If hlObj.GetValue("CaseGeneral.CostCenter",0,0,0,0) = "" Then CostC = hlCaller.GetValue ("PersonBilling.CostCenter_CA.CostCenter",0,CCContID(0),0,0) hlObj.SetValue "CaseGeneral.CostCenter",0,0,0,CostC End If End If End If End If End If
If NoAsset = False Then 'Setzen des Inventars 'Setting the asset varString="" varAType = hlProduct.GetType () If varAType = "DesktopComputer" Or varAType = "ServerComputer" Or varAType = "NotebookComputer" Or varAType = "Printer" Then If EditHostname.Text <> "" Then varString = EditHostname.Text If EditAssetModel.Text<>"" Then varString = varString & " " & EditAssetModel.Text Else If EditAssetModel.Text<>"" Then varString=EditAssetModel.Text Else EditAssetModel.Text=" " End If EditAssetModel.Text = varString
'Kostenstelle im Vorgang setzen, wenn keine Person vorhanden ist. 'Set cost center in the Case, if no person exists. If ReadOnly = False Then If hlObj.GetValue("CaseGeneral.CostCenter",0,0,0,0) = "" Then CostC = hlProduct.GetValue("AssetGeneral.CostCenter",0,0,0,0) hlObj.SetValue "CaseGeneral.CostCenter",0,0,0,CostC End If End If End If
'Dieser Scriptteil setzt abhängig von der In2Desk Sprache die Vorschlagsliste 'für die Reaktionszeit und Lösungszeit und bestimmt die Default Reaktionszeit 'This script sets depending on the language chosen for In2Desk the suggestion 'list for the reaction and solution time and determines the default reaction time DefReacTime = "" Select Case LangID Case "7" 'Setzen der deutschen Vorschlagsliste für Reaktionszeiten 'Setting the German suggestion list for reaction times Counter=EditReactionTime.GetItemsCount If Counter <= 0 Then EditReactionTime.AddItem "Sofort" EditReactionTime.AddItem "2 Stunden" EditReactionTime.AddItem "4 Stunden" EditReactionTime.AddItem "8 Stunden" EditReactionTime.AddItem "1 Tag" EditReactionTime.AddItem "2 Tage" EditReactionTime.AddItem "4 Tage" EditReactionTime.AddItem "5 Tage" EditReactionTime.AddItem "10 Tage" EditReactionTime.AddItem "20 Tage" End If DefReacTime = "2 Stunden"
'Setzen der deutschen Vorschlagsliste für Versprochene Lösungszeit 'Setting the German suggestion list for agreed solution time Counter=EditPromisedSolutionTime.GetItemsCount If Counter <= 0 Then EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "Sofort" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "2 Stunden" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "4 Stunden" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "8 Stunden" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "1 Tag" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "2 Tage" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "4 Tage" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "5 Tage" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "10 Tage" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "20 Tage" End If
Case "9" 'Setzen der englischen Vorschlagsliste für Reaktionszeiten 'Setting the English suggestion list for reaction time Counter=EditReactionTime.GetItemsCount If Counter <= 0 Then EditReactionTime.AddItem "Immediately" EditReactionTime.AddItem "2 hours" EditReactionTime.AddItem "4 hours" EditReactionTime.AddItem "8 hours" EditReactionTime.AddItem "1 day" EditReactionTime.AddItem "2 days" EditReactionTime.AddItem "4 days" EditReactionTime.AddItem "5 days" EditReactionTime.AddItem "10 days" EditReactionTime.AddItem "20 days" End If DefReacTime = "2 hours"
'Setzen der englischen Vorschlagsliste für Versprochene Lösungszeit 'Setting the English suggestion list for agreed solution time Counter=EditPromisedSolutionTime.GetItemsCount If Counter <= 0 Then EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "Immediately" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "2 hours" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "4 hours" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "8 hours" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "1 day" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "2 days" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "4 days" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "5 days" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "10 days" EditPromisedSolutionTime.AddItem "20 days" End If
End Select
'Setzten der Standard Reaktionszeit auf den Wert aus der Varianblen DefReacTime 'Setting the default reaction time for the value retrieved from the variable DefReacTime If ReadOnly=False Then If EditReactionTime.Text = "" Then hlObj.SetValue "CASEINFO.REACTIONTIME",0,0,0,DefReacTime End If
'Rote Titel-Beschriftung des Lösungstextfeldes bei Inc.-Status Gelöst/Geschlosssen. 'Redcoloured title of the solutiontext-frame if Inc.-status Solved or Closed. Dim strIncStatus:strIncStatus = hlObj.GetValue("IncidentAttribute.IncidentStatus",0,0,0,0) If strIncStatus = "IncidentStatusSolved" Or strIncStatus = "IncidentStatusClosed" Then CaseSolution.TitleTextColor = "Red" End If

anyType.Code: 'Wenn der Status der vorherigen SU geschlossen oder geloest war, setze den Status auf "zu prüfen" 'If status of the last SU was closed or solved, set status to "to proof" Dim GetLastSUIdx GetLastSUIdx = 0 Dim suindices suindices = hlobj.GetSvcUnitIndices() GetLastSUIdx = UBound(suindices) Dim SUStatus SUStatus = hlObj.getValue("IncidentSUAttribute.IncidentStatus",0,0,GetLastSUIdx,0) If SUStatus = "IncidentStatusClosed" Or SUStatus = "IncidentStatusSolved" Then hlObj.SetValue"IncidentAttribute.IncidentStatus",0,0,0,"IncidentStatusToProof" End If

'Ermitteln der Benachrichtigung 'Selecting the notifictaion Valid=hlCaller.HasContent("PersonGeneral.DefaultNotification",0,0) If Valid = 1 Then Notify = hlCaller.GetValue("PersonGeneral.DefaultNotification",0,0,0,1) hlObj.SetValue "CaseGeneral.DefaultNotification",0,0,0,Notify End If
'Ermitteln der Kostenstellen des Anfragers und füllen der Auswahlliste 'Selecting the cost center assigned to the requester and filling the selection list CounterC=EditCostCenter.GetItemsCount If CounterC > 0 Then For k=0 To CounterC - 1 EditCostCenter.DeleteItem 0 Next End If CounterC=EditCostCenter.GetItemsCount If CounterC <= 1 Then CCContID = hlCaller.GetContentIDs ("PersonBilling.CostCenter_CA",0) val=ubound(CCContID) If val >= 0 Then For j=0 To val CostC = hlCaller.GetValue ("PersonBilling.CostCenter_CA.CostCenter",0,CCContID(j),0,0) EditCostCenter.AddItem "" & CostC & "" Next If hlObj.GetValue ("CaseGeneral.CostCenter",0,0,0,0) = "" Then CostC = hlCaller.GetValue ("PersonBilling.CostCenter_CA.CostCenter",0,CCContID(0),0,0) hlObj.SetValue "CaseGeneral.CostCenter",0,0,0,CostC End If End If End If End If
